diagnosis.what_happened: The validator agent issued a PASS on regression deliverables that reported regressions in a single consolidated table instead of 3 tables per model.
diagnosis.behavior_caused_outcome: Verification scripts only tested superficial XML typography and numerical values against JSON keys, without testing architectural compliance against the institutional 3-table standard.
diagnosis.what_should_have_happened: The validator must enforce structural compliance and fail-closed: if a regression hypothesis is presented in a consolidated format, it must immediately issue FAIL.
diagnosis.rationale_why: Validators that only check superficial formatting without validating structural domain standards create false confidence and allow non-compliant deliverables through the gate.

desired_behavior: Enforce fail-closed structural validation for regression models: exactly 3 tables per model (Correlations, ANOVA 11-col, Coefficients 8-col), failing any deliverable that consolidates them.
generalization: Superficial verification is insufficient; institutional structural invariants (like the 3-table regression suite) must be treated as explicit hard-coded failure conditions.

evidence.threshold_value: Strict verification FAIL on missing 3-table architecture
